name: dns_auto_evolution
description:
Decide, per candidate domain harvested from the bypass router's DNS logs,
whether it must be pinned to domestic resolution (the auto-evolution step of
the Feishu-style fix). The harness fills five evidence fields; the graph
reads nothing else:
- ev_domain    the candidate domain, e.g. "www.feishu.cn".
- ev_drift     "overseas" (clash DNS returned an overseas edge while a
direct domestic DoH returned a domestic one), "none" (no
drift), or "unknown".
- ev_kind      "domestic" (.cn / .com.cn / domestic CDN shapes / geosite:cn
hint), "foreign", or "unknown".
- ev_pinned    "yes" (already in nameserver-policy / fake-ip-filter /
DIRECT rules) or "no".
- ev_outbound  "proxy" (clash returned a fake-ip 198.18.x for it, i.e. the
rule sends it through the proxy), "direct", or "unknown".
Decision ladder (first-fail):
1. drift     -- no drift: nothing to do. unknown: needs a human look.
2. kind      -- foreign by design: do not touch. unknown: review.
3. pinned    -- already pinned: nothing new to apply.
4. outbound  -- proxy: pin DNS + fake-ip-filter + DIRECT rule.
direct/unknown: pin DNS + fake-ip-filter only.
Emitted labels: SKIP_NO_DRIFT, SKIP_FOREIGN, SKIP_ALREADY, REVIEW,
ADD_DNS_PIN, ADD_DNS_PIN_DIRECT.

drift_state.instructions: Did clash DNS return an overseas edge while a direct domestic DoH returned a domestic one? overseas = real drift worth fixing; none = both agree; unknown = the cross-check could not be completed.

criteria.overseas: clash answered with an overseas IP; direct domestic DoH answered domestic.
criteria.none: clash and direct DoH agree; no drift.
criteria.unknown: The cross-check could not be completed.

kind_state.instructions: Is this domain a domestic service by shape (.cn / .com.cn / domestic CDN suffix / geosite:cn)? foreign = it is meant to be overseas; unknown = cannot tell.

criteria.domestic: The domain shape says it is a domestic service.
criteria.foreign: The domain is a foreign service by design.
criteria.unknown: The domain's intent cannot be determined.

pinned_state.instructions: Is this domain already covered by the DNS optimization (nameserver-policy / fake-ip-filter / DIRECT rules)? yes = already applied, nothing new.

criteria.yes: Already pinned in at least one of the optimization lists.

outbound_state.instructions: What outbound does this domain's rule use? proxy (clash returned a fake-ip 198.18.x for it) means it also needs a DIRECT rule; direct/unknown means DNS pinning suffices.

criteria.proxy: The rule sends this domain through the proxy (fake-ip answer).
criteria.direct: The rule already sends this domain direct.
